description: This file defines React components for a resizable panel UI, including a panel group, individual panels, and resize handles, utilizing external libraries for resizable panels and icons.

methods.name: ResizablePanelGroup
methods.description: React component that renders a group of resizable panels with customizable className and props.

methods.name: ResizablePanel
methods.description: React component that renders an individual resizable panel with passed props.

methods.name: ResizableHandle
methods.description: React component that renders a resize handle, optionally with a grip icon, styled for vertical resizing.
